final_lessons: For this bigram LM, Adam at lr 0.0003 with a shallow wide transformer can beat AdamW lr 0.001, which appears too aggressive.
Do not dismiss SGD momentum: with a large transformer and strong L1 it can beat conservative Adam on this bigram test CE.
SGD momentum needs enough lr and the right regularizer here; lr 0.001 with L2 underperforms the stronger Adam baseline.
The shallow d_model 128 Adam lr 0.0003 cross-entropy setup is a reliable anchor; AdamW lr 0.0001 and Adagrad remain weaker.
AdamW lr 0.001 is especially risky on this dataset; moderate AdamW lr 0.0003 can beat Adagrad and small SGD variants.
RMSprop lr 0.003 with a large deep transformer underperforms badly here; prefer the proven Adam lr 0.0003 anchors.
The best anchor so far is SGD momentum lr 0.01 on a d_model 128 two-layer transformer with strong L1 regularization.
Small AdamW lr 0.0003 is decent but still trails the d_model 128 Adam lr 0.0003 anchor.
Very high AdamW lr 0.003 is also poor here, reinforcing that AdamW should not be chosen over proven Adam or strong SGD anchors.
No-momentum SGD at lr 0.0003 severely undertrains, so even an aggressive small Adam candidate is preferable.
